context.title: Deployment context
context.description: Labels describing where this release runs. They only affect the labels of the objects this chart creates.

operator.title: UnifAI operator
operator.description: The operator is cluster-wide : install it once per cluster.

enabled.description: Install the operator. Set to false when it already runs on the cluster.

image.description: Operator image reference, preferably pinned by digest.

imagePullPolicy.description: Image pull policy of the operator.

imagePullSecrets.description: Pull secrets for the operator image.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits of the operator container.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector of the operator pod.

userRoles.description: Create the unifai-view, unifai-edit and unifai-admin ClusterRoles.

serviceMonitor.description: Create a ServiceMonitor for the operator metrics (requires the prometheus-operator CRDs).

stack.title: UnifAI platform
stack.description: One UnifaiStack resource named unifai, created in the release namespace.

spec.description: Content of the UnifaiStack spec, passed as is to the operator. It is validated by the UnifaiStack CRD ; see kubectl explain unifaistack.spec --recursive.

version.description: Tag of the UnifAI application images.

imageRegistry.description: Registry holding the UnifAI application images.

images.description: Image overrides per component (rag, multiagent, backend, identity, ui, mongodb, qdrant, rabbitmq, redis, redisInsight, temporal, docling, embedding, reranker).

identity.description: Identity provider : keycloak (managed by the operator, OpenShift only) or external (your own Keycloak). Setting external replaces keycloak.

adminUsers.description: Keycloak user names granted the UnifAI administrator role.

clientSecret.description: Secret holding the OIDC client secret, created beforehand in the release namespace.

replicas.description: Pod count by component. Only multiagent (the multiagent-be Deployment, not its Temporal worker), from 1 to 10. Unset keeps the chart count and changes nothing ; setting it upgrades the multiagent-be release once, which normally restarts its pod once. dev runs exactly this count, prod raises the autoscaler minimum to it. More than one pod needs a ReadWriteMany shared storage (storage.sharedClassName). Also validated by the UnifaiStack CRD of operator 0.1.77 and later.

className.description: Class for ReadWriteOnce volumes ; empty means the cluster default.

sharedClassName.description: Class for ReadWriteMany volumes ; empty means the cluster default.

type.description: route : OpenShift Routes created by the operator. ingress : Ingresses created by this chart. none : nothing published.

domain.description: DNS domain of the published hosts. Required with type ingress ; empty on OpenShift means the cluster apps domain.

className.description: Ingress class name ; empty means the cluster default.

uiAnnotations.description: Annotations added to the web interface Ingress only.

tlsSecretName.description: Existing TLS Secret presented by the Ingresses. Required with type ingress.

installRouteCRD.description: Install a schema-less Route CRD for clusters without the OpenShift Route API. Never enable it on OpenShift.

createUiServingCert.description: Generate the self-signed Secret unifai-ui-tls served by the web interface on its internal port.

project.title: Namespace creation
project.description: Optional project sub-chart creating the namespace. Disabled by default.
